crossRefs.note: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

translations.web: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.
translations.bsb: The fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it must not be extinguished.
translations.kjv: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
translations.asv: Fire shall be kept burning upon the altar continually; it shall not go out.
